svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Spine 529 on the ground, toward the frame; cross feet 400 (seat end)

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and 300 (under the pedal post), welded under it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pedal post 393 tall on the spine, 185 from its far end; weld a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bottom bracket shell cut from a scrap bicycle frame on top, its

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: axis across the machine, centre 438 above the ground.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Seat tube: round 32 x 2 tube, 675 long, 172 behind the pedal post;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: slot its top 40 mm and fit a bicycle seat clamp.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top arm 504 from the seat tube to the frame end, 600 to 625 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: End plates 80 wide, 6 mm, welded across the spine end (125 tall)

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and the top arm end (65 tall); two 9 mm holes in each.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the lower plate bolts to the low end member, the upper plate

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: to the end post; four M8 bolts. Outrigger 6 mm clear of the frame.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: bottom bracket axis square to the spine and level.
